catalogue.title: Products & prices
catalogue.noCategories: Add a category first (for example: Eggs).
catalogue.noProducts: No products in this category yet.
catalogue.gstHint: Fresh eggs and fresh chicken are generally GST-exempt (0%). Confirm with your CA.

slots.title: Delivery slots
slots.none: No slots yet. Customers can't check out until you add one.

customers.title: Customers
customers.overLimit: Over the credit limit of {limit}. The owner should decide on new credit orders.
customers.name: Name
customers.trustedHint: Small, usual orders skip the confirmation call. Large orders are still called.
customers.optInHint: Turn on only if the customer agreed.
customers.notesHint: e.g. Call son's number after 6 PM

settings.title: Farm settings
settings.whatsappHint: Leave empty to use the contact number.
settings.upiHint: Customers pay straight into your account. No fees.
settings.gstinHint: Leave empty if not registered; invoices become a bill of supply.

features.title: Features
features.hint: Switch on only what your farm needs. You can change this any time.

webShop.title: Web shop ordering
webShop.hint: Customers order straight from the shop link. When off, they browse and then call or WhatsApp you.

callConfirmation.title: Confirm orders by call
callConfirmation.hint: Orders wait until someone calls the customer. When off, orders are confirmed at once.

stockTracking.title: Stock tracking
stockTracking.hint: Counts stock for each product and shows 'sold out' at zero. Turn off if your supply varies day to day.

creditAccounts.title: Credit accounts (khata)
creditAccounts.hint: Regular customers can pay later; dues and credit limits are tracked.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.hint: A numbered invoice is issued automatically on delivery.

whatsappLite.title: WhatsApp message buttons
whatsappLite.hint: Send a ready-made WhatsApp message to the customer in one tap.

upiPayments.title: UPI payment links
upiPayments.hint: Shows a 'Pay by UPI' button on invoices (needs your UPI ID).

subscriptions.title: Weekly / daily plans
subscriptions.hint: Repeat orders such as eggs every week or milk every day. Turn on only if your supply is steady.

broadcasts.title: WhatsApp broadcasts
broadcasts.hint: Tell opted-in customers about a fresh batch in one go.

whatsappCloud.title: Automated WhatsApp
whatsappCloud.hint: Menus, order forms and automatic updates inside WhatsApp. A small charge per message.

reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: Daily sales, product totals and Excel exports for your accountant.

orderForm.fromCallHint: Make the changes agreed on the call and save. Saving confirms the order.
